connect.plug: Connect the phone with a USB cable. If this is the first time, enable USB debugging:
connect.unauthorized: Phone detected but not authorized — confirm “Allow USB debugging?” on the phone screen.
connect.offline: The phone is offline — unplug and reconnect the cable.
connect.many: Several phones are connected — pick one:
connect.adb_missing: The adb program was not found.

samsung.s3: Settings → Developer options → turn on “USB debugging”
samsung.s4: Connect the cable and tap “Allow” on the phone (tick “Always allow”)

xiaomi.s3: Settings → Additional settings → Developer options → “USB debugging”
xiaomi.s4: Also turn on “USB debugging (Security settings)” — needs a SIM card and a Mi account
xiaomi.s5: Connect the cable and allow debugging on the phone

motorola.s4: Connect the cable and allow debugging on the phone

oppo.s3: Settings → Additional settings → Developer options → “USB debugging”
oppo.s4: If there is “Disable permission monitoring”, turn it on
oppo.s5: Connect the cable and allow debugging on the phone

huawei.s3: Settings → System & updates → Developer options → “USB debugging”
huawei.s4: Connect the cable, choose “File transfer” and allow debugging

pixel.s4: Connect the cable and allow debugging on the phone

other.s3: Go back and open “Developer options” → “USB debugging”
other.s4: Connect the cable and allow debugging on the phone

summary.advice: We recommend removing or disabling them. Every change can be undone.
summary.review: A few apps are worth a look — nothing is selected for repair.
summary.low_data: Little behavior data (the phone was restarted recently) — ratings may be too low.

plan.title: Repair plan
plan.undo_hint: Every change can be undone in History.
plan.nothing: Nothing to run — all apps are blocked.

exec.title: Repair · {order}

result.still_active: Still active — the change did not hold ({kinds})

admin.title: One tap needed on the phone

admin.title: Admin rights were not removed
admin.text: {name} is still a device admin. Try again?

interrupted.disconnected: The phone was disconnected during order {order}. Reconnect and scan it, then finish or undo the order.

history.title: Order history
history.admin_note: Undo does not restore device admin rights.

settings.title: Settings
settings.service_soon: Service details for the report — coming soon.

console.placeholder: adb shell command, e.g. dumpsys package com.example
console.warn_text: Console commands bypass the change journal and cannot be undone. Continue?
console.disabled: The console works with a scanned phone while no order is running.

close.title: An order is running
close.message: Pause after the current step and close the program? The order can be finished or undone later.

error.adb_missing: The adb program was not found. Point to adb.exe in the settings.
error.unauthorized: The phone is not authorized — confirm the prompt on the phone.
error.offline: The phone is offline — reconnect the cable.
error.timeout: The phone did not answer in time.
error.busy: Another task is running — wait for it to finish.
error.wrong_device: Connect phone {serial}, which this order is for.
error.no_device: Connect and scan a phone first.
error.nothing_to_resume: This order has no steps left to finish.
error.nothing_to_do: Nothing to run — the selected apps are blocked.
error.no_target: No such app or step in the order.
